info.name: Create large images for all items within a folder.

params.name: createJobs
params.description: If true, a job will be used to create the image when needed; if always, a job will always be used; if false, a job will never be used, creating a version of the image in a preferred format.

params.name: localJobs
params.description: If true, run each creation job locally; if false, run via the remote worker.

params.name: recurse
params.description: If true, items in child folders will also be checked.

params.name: cancelJobs
params.description: If true, unfinished large image job(s) associated with items in the folder will be canceled, then a new large image created; if false, items with an unfinished large image will be skipped.

params.name: redoExisting
params.description: If true, existing large images should be removed and recreated. Otherwise they will be skipped.

items.docs: Does not work for new items with multiple files.

info.name: Count the number of cached thumbnail files for large_image items.

params.name: spec
params.description: A JSON list of thumbnail specifications to count.  If empty, all cached thumbnails are counted.  The specifications typically include width, height, encoding, and encoding options.

items.docs: Count the number of cached thumbnail files for large_image items.

info.name: Create cached thumbnail files from large_image items.

params.name: spec
params.description: A JSON list of thumbnail specifications to create.  The specifications typically include width, height, encoding, and encoding options.

params.name: logInterval
params.description: The number of seconds between log messages.  This also determines how often the creation job is checked if it has been canceled or deleted.  A value of 0 will log after each thumbnail is checked or created.

params.name: concurrent
params.description: The number of concurrent threads to use when making thumbnails.  0 or unspecified to base this on the number of reported cpus.

items.docs: This creates a local job that processes all large_image items.  A common spec for the Girder API is: [{"width": 160, "height": 100}, {"width": 160, "height": 100, "imageKey": "macro"}, {"width": 160, "height": 100, "imageKey": "label"}]

info.name: Delete cached thumbnail files from large_image items.

params.name: spec
params.description: A JSON list of thumbnail specifications to delete.  If empty, all cached thumbnails are deleted.  The specifications typically include width, height, encoding, and encoding options.

items.docs: Delete cached thumbnail files from large_image items.

info.name: Remove large images from items where the large image job incomplete.

items.docs: This is used to clean up all large image conversion jobs that have failed to complete.  If a job is in progress, it will be cancelled.  The return value is the number of items that were adjusted.
